description: About the Event PROTOTHON 2k26 is a 24-hour national-level hackathon designed to inspire innovation, teamwork, and rapid prototyping. Organised by the Department of Electronics and Communication Engineering, Hindustan Institute of Technology and Science (HITS), Chennai, the event brings together innovators, designers, and developers to solve real-world challenges through creative and technology-driven solutions. It encourages participants to think beyond conventional boundaries, develop functional prototypes, and present impactful ideas within a limited timeframe. More than just a competition, PROTOTHON serves as a dynamic platform to innovate, collaborate, and showcase technical prowess in an electrifying, time-bound environment. Objective The objective of PROTOTHON 2K26 is to foster innovation and creative problem-solving through technology-driven solutions. It aims to empower participants to design and prototype impactful ideas that address real-world challenges within 24 hours. Protothon 2 K26 – Time Cycle Round 1 – Ideate Presentation of ideas. Identification of the problem and proposed solution. Round 2 – Development and Progress Partial prototype development. Demonstration of technical progress. Round 3 – Competition and Impact Final prototype presentation. Final evaluation and judgement of the developed prototype. Scheduled on Day 2 – December 9, 2026. Event Details Event: PROTOTHON 2K26 Date: December 8 & 9, 2026 Registration Link : https://protothon-2k26.vercel.app/ Duration: 24 Hours Venue: Dr. MGR Auditorium, Hindustan Institute of Technology and Science, Rajiv Gandhi Salai (OMR), Padur, (Via) Kelambakkam, Chennai – 603 103, Tamil Nadu, India. Event Schedule Day 1 – December 8, 2026 Reporting / Commencement: 09:00 AM Hackathon continues overnight. Day 2 – December 9, 2026 Event proceedings: 09:00 AM – 01:00 PM Contact Details Dr AL Vallikannu,Head of Department - ECE, Convenor 97896 68280 Dr G Vimalarani Associate Professor - ECE,Faculty Coordinator 9940

About the Event

  • PROTOTHON 2k26 is a 24-hour national-level hackathon designed to inspire innovation, teamwork, and rapid prototyping. Organised by the Department of Electronics and Communication Engineering, Hindustan Institute of Technology and Science (HITS), Chennai, the event brings together innovators, designers, and developers to solve real-world challenges through creative and technology-driven solutions.
  • It encourages participants to think beyond conventional boundaries, develop functional prototypes, and present impactful ideas within a limited timeframe. More than just a competition, PROTOTHON serves as a dynamic platform to innovate, collaborate, and showcase technical prowess in an electrifying, time-bound environment.

Objective

  • The objective of PROTOTHON 2K26 is to foster innovation and creative problem-solving through technology-driven solutions. It aims to empower participants to design and prototype impactful ideas that address real-world challenges within 24 hours.

Protothon 2 K26 – Time Cycle

Round 1 – Ideate

  • Presentation of ideas.
  • Identification of the problem and proposed solution.

Round 2 – Development and Progress

  • Partial prototype development.
  • Demonstration of technical progress.

Round 3 – Competition and Impact

  • Final prototype presentation.
  • Final evaluation and judgement of the developed prototype.

Scheduled on Day 2 – December 9, 2026.

Event Details

  • Event: PROTOTHON 2K26
  • Date: December 8 & 9, 2026
  • Registration Link : https://protothon-2k26.vercel.app/
  • Duration: 24 Hours
  • Venue: Dr. MGR Auditorium, Hindustan Institute of Technology and Science, Rajiv Gandhi Salai (OMR), Padur, (Via) Kelambakkam, Chennai – 603 103, Tamil Nadu, India.

Event Schedule

  • Day 1 – December 8, 2026
